title: AI-as-Orienter — Non-Adoption Pending Operational Criterion
summary: The methodology does not adopt AI-as-orienter (agent-mediated, interactive first-encounter schema-building) as a structural pattern in Cycle 017. Adoption is blocked pending an operational criterion that distinguishes it in observable behavior, not only stated intent, from the rejected AI-as-prosthetic pattern; the essay-grounded failure mode is usage drift, where an orienter role gradually shades into a prosthetic one. The methodology's default position (corpus directly readable; agent assists pragmatic work) holds, with in-place restructuring, companion files, F-pattern leads, and brief purpose-built on-ramps remaining as the admissible document-level interventions. The bounded AID-gate dialogue pattern is explicitly unaffected. Three named conditions (empirical study, a literature finding, or a structurally-bounded methodology-internal prototype) could warrant revisiting in a future cycle.
workflow_point: DECIDE resolution of the AI-as-orienter vs. AI-as-prosthetic value tension (T5)
mechanism: non-adoption pending an operational criterion; three named future-cycle conditions for revisiting
